title: Partnership Over Ownership
definition: The principle that relationships between entities within the CADMIES ecosystem are based on partnership rather than ownership.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Collaborating with others, rather than trying to control them, in the CADMIES ecosystem.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Establishing partnerships with other entities, rather than trying to acquire or dominate them, in the CADMIES ecosystem.
difficulty_levels.expert: Advocating for partnership as a foundational principle within the CADMIES ecosystem, emphasizing collaboration and mutual respect over ownership and control.

extra_fields.insight: Relationships within the CADMIES ecosystem are based on partnership rather than ownership.
